description: Header file defining the API for emulated GPIO in Zephyr OS, including functions for setting input states, reading output states, and retrieving pin flags.

methods.name: gpio_emul_input_set_masked
methods.description: Sets the input values for multiple emulated GPIO pins based on a mask.

methods.name: gpio_emul_input_set
methods.description: Sets the input value for a single emulated GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_emul_output_get_masked
methods.description: Reads the output values for multiple emulated GPIO pins based on a mask.

methods.name: gpio_emul_output_get
methods.description: Reads the output value of a single emulated GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_emul_flags_get
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration flags for a specific emulated GPIO pin.
